description: Image Description: The image depicts a small vegetable garden bed bordered by wooden planks. The garden is located in a grassy area with well-maintained grass surrounding it. In the garden bed, there are multiple rows of plants. Some of these plants appear to be young and are spaced evenly in lines. There are wire cages placed over some sections, likely for supporting vine plants as they grow.
